name: Malian Djembe Drum

# Malian Djembe Drum, Khadi Wood, 330mm/ 13"

\\nThe Malian djembe drum is a beautifully carved instrument with a  khadi wood shell with a medium heavy to medium Australian goat skin.\\nOne of the original djembe woods these drums have that dry African sound reminiscent of the hot dusty Malian country side. The Malian Djembe drum is a  professional level instrument with amazing bass, tone, and slap definition. For serious players, music lovers,  and people wanting an instrument that will last them forever.
